feature: 10-second straight ground test with command lease
physical_ground_tests: N 10-second straight: user reports approximately straight, slight right drift; automatic zero output verified. No distance/offset measurement.
limitations: Physical speed and travel distance uncalibrated; equal encoder targets do not guarantee straight trajectory.
startup_detection: at least 5 counts/10ms for 3 consecutive ticks per wheel, within 200ms after motor onset
reason: Loaded left-turn inner wheel reported 16..18 counts; old 20-count startup threshold faulted despite actual forward movement. Reproduced by failing host regression.
keepalive_failure: FAULT_LINK, both outputs zero and steering centered
scene_user_confirmation: At least 5m ahead, 1m each side clear, no people nearby.
